sloka: यथा ऽहं तस्य वीरस्य वनादुपधिना हृता ।रक्षसा तद्भया देव तथा नार्हति राघवः ।। ५.६८.१३ ।।।।
transliteration: yathā 'haṁ tasya vīrasya vanādupadhinā hṛtā ।rakṣasā tadbhayā deva tathā nārhati rāghavaḥ ।। 5.68.13 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Tell valiant Rama not to take me back the way Ravana, the demon abducted me out of fear. Which is not right.
